Page 1056 
Lenmeldy (atidarsagene autotemcel) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-147672  
Guideline Name 
Lenmeldy (atidarsagene autotemcel)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
6/1/2024  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Lenmeldy  
Approval Length 
1 Time Authorization in Lifetime*  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting both of the following:  
• 
Diagnosis of metachromatic leukodystrophy (MLD)  
• 
Molecular genetic testing confirms mutation in the arylsulfatase A (ARSA) gene  


=== PDF PAGE 1057 ===
Page 1057 
 
AND 
 
2 - Disease is one of the following:  
 
 2.1 Pre-symptomatic late infantile (PSLI) as confirmed by both of the following:  
 
  2.1.1 Disease onset at less than or equal to 30 months of age  
 
AND 
 
  2.1.2 One of the following:  
• 
Absence of neurological signs and symptoms of MLD (e.g., peripheral neuropathy, gait 
difficulties, hypotonia)  
• 
Abnormal reflexes or abnormalities on brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and/or 
nerve conduction tests not associated with functional impairment (e.g., no tremor, no 
peripheral ataxia)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 Pre-symptomatic early juvenile (PSEJ) as confirmed by both of the following:  
 
  2.2.1 Disease onset at greater than 30 months and less than 7 years of age  
 
AND 
 
  2.2.2 One of the following:  
• 
Absence of neurological signs and symptoms of MLD (e.g., peripheral neuropathy, gait 
difficulties, hypotonia)  
• 
Abnormal reflexes or abnormalities on brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and/or 
nerve conduction tests not associated with functional impairment (e.g., no tremor, no 
peripheral ataxia)  
 
OR 
 
 2.3 Early-symptomatic early juvenile (ESEJ) as confirmed by all of the following:  
• 
Disease onset at greater than 30 months and less than 7 years of age  


=== PDF PAGE 1058 ===
Page 1058 
• 
Gross motor function classification (GMFC)-MLD score less than or equal to 1  
• 
Intelligence quotient (IQ) of greater than or equal to 85  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by a specialist with expertise in MLD at an authorized treatment center  
 
AND 
 
4 - Both of the following:  
• 
Patient has never received Lenmeldy treatment in their lifetime  
• 
Patient has never received prior hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT)  
Notes  
*Per prescribing information, Lenmeldy is for one-time, single dose int
ravenous use only.
